attempts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: minimal square Palari avatar icon

Input image: Image 1 is identity reference only. Derive the exact shell/aperture silhouette, crown, pose, and eye attitude from it. Do not edit or copy its plaster scene, floor, contact shadow, ceramic material realism, lighting, or texture.

Primary request: Create one highly simplified IP mascot logo, not a character illustration. Make the shell-and-aperture relationship the primary recognizable mark and keep the Palari six-aperture seed only as a tiny secondary species signature.

Identity to preserve: upright seed-pod silhouette with integrated dome, one asymmetric side leaf-shaped aperture, one raised greeting arm, one resting arm, and two calm half-lidded eyes.

Background: fully opaque edge-to-edge perfectly solid #172333 deep navy, square outer corners. The background is not a scene and has no variation.
Palette: exactly three semantic colors in the complete icon: warm ivory #E9E6DF for the fused outer shell and arms, #164A7A for the one large continuous recessed intelligence aperture and restrained iris accents, and #172333 only for the background and genuine negative-space cutouts. No fourth color.
Geometry: 6–10 broad rounded geometric forms. Treat the outer shell and both arms as one fused continuous ivory silhouette, use one defining colored aperture region, exactly two calm half-lidded eyes, and the exact six-hole seed as small background-revealing negative space. The seed is a compact 2-column × 3-row arrangement: two larger holes on top, two smaller holes in the middle, two larger holes on bottom. No extra decorations.
Composition: upright, emerging from the lower-right corner, filling 78–84% of the square. Keep all defining crown/arm features visible; intentional bottom/side crop is allowed but do not crop the crown, raised arm, paired arms, eyes, opening, or six-hole seed. No tilt.
Readability: design the black silhouette and shell/aperture cutout to remain recognizable at true 32 × 32 even if the tiny seed becomes secondary. Use thick, rounded, weighty contours; visibly blunt every tip and avoid narrow fragile gaps.
Style: flat-first geometry with continuous-gradient neo-skeuomorphic micro-volume only. Use one uninterrupted low-frequency diffuse gradient per large IP color region with a shared upper-left-to-lower-right light direction; every transition spans at least half the form. Keep peak-to-peak lightness variation <= 0.08, hue drift <= 3 degrees, chroma drift <= 0.015. Modeling is visible at full size but nearly disappears at 32 × 32. Keep the background perfectly flat.
Face: exactly two eyes and no mouth. No eyebrows, nose, catchlight dots, or separate facial highlights.
Canvas: direct 1:1 native square, fully opaque, edge-to-edge background, square outer corners; preserve the native output without resampling.

Forbid: character illustration, studio scene, alcove, floor, material realism, ceramic/clay/plastic/toy rendering, texture, gloss, bevel, rim light, extrusion, strong 3D, cast shadow, external shadow, halo, vignette, spotlight, background gradient, border, frame, card, App icon mask, rounded canvas corners, transparency, text, watermark, mouth, realistic hands, fingers, legs, feet, clothes, machinery, thin lines, sharp points, repeated anatomy, decorative marks, extra apertures, extra colors, discrete highlight patches, closed highlight blobs, overlay bands, nested shadow shapes, cut-paper layers, cel-shading, stepped tonal swatches, hard internal shadow boundaries, small glossy hotspots, or independently lit facial details.

failures: Background is a visible navy gradient rather than a perfectly solid field
Modeling is too volumetric for flat-first logo geometry
